decisions.question: Gate 1, hero concepts: which elf ranger (Forest resistance defender, player-elf) concept should go to TRELLIS?

decisions.decision: Approve hd-s42, then add a rear-view concept: 3 local Qwen candidates, about 55 GPU-min, projected in the cook (Recommended)
decisions.question: Gate 2, the unrigged 3D meshes: what should I do with the elf? (board 127.0.0.1:47841; measured limitations stated: invented near-black back on every seed, soft faces with smeared eye sockets, mitten hands, pointed ears only in texture, HD indistinguishable from default at 18-40 m)
conditions: A rear-view concept is generated locally (Qwen Image Edit Plus 2511 in WanGP, Scene mode), painted over an orthographic back render of hd-s42 with the approved front concept as identity reference; three candidates; the user selects one.
The selected rear view is projected onto back-visible texels only, occlusion-tested and blended at the sides; the front keeps the TRELLIS texture from the approved concept.
Cook repairs: remove specks, separate or curl the mitten hands, clean the face and skin, decimate to the 16k hero budget with baked normals and 1024 maps; consider small pointed ear geometry.

decisions.decision: Ship the calibrated heroes and soldier cook-016
decisions.question: Gate 3 final approval: ship the three heroes tone-calibrated (recommended) or as cooked, together with the line soldier cook-016 Run fix, as shown in the running game?

supplementary.question: Hero rear views, elf ranger: which rear view should the elf use? (7121 faithful continuation; 7222 best registration but invented gold-leaf embroidery and looped hip strap; 7323 satchel and ponytail, weakest registration)
